audience: app teams that track sessions and users with Countly analytics

useCases.title: Get the dashboard summary of an app
useCases.text: List the apps you can read, with their IDs. Get the summary cards of one app for a period, with the change against the previous period.

useCases.title: Track sessions and new users over time
useCases.text: Get the session timeline of one app, with one row per day or per month. Each row has sessions, new users, total users and duration.

useCases.title: Compare countries and app versions
useCases.text: Get the top countries of one app for today, the last 7 days and the last 30 days. Get one breakdown, such as users by platform or app version.

useCases.title: Measure how often users come back
useCases.text: Get the share of users in each session-count bucket for one app and period. Use it to see how often users return.

useCases.title: Check the access of the API key
useCases.text: Read the dashboard user that the key belongs to, with its permissions. Get the settings of one app, when that user administers it.
